# Method reference

This page lists jobs that belong to a particular kind of thing in the Rust engine.

Each line has the code name first and then a short, simple clue about what that job helps with.

Keeping a job next to the thing it works on helps programmers avoid mixing up important information.

## `native/crates/lighthouse-core/src/analytics.rs`

- `DirectiveScrubber::finish` - Finishes a job and tidies up.
- `DirectiveScrubber::full_text` - Helps the app do its job.
